video_title: Richard ‘The Rizard’ Jefferson | Delly Love, Olympics Rage Bait & LeBron James GOAT Debate

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the 2016 NBA Finals win with the Cleveland Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: It was a special trip and one of the things that I was probably most excited about

text_blocks.speaker: James Brayshaw
text_blocks.text: Your career was simply ridiculous. 17 seasons in the NBA, eight teams. And included in that, the 2016 win for the Cleveland Cavaliers.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: It was a special trip and one of the things that I was probably most excited about was that we were the first team to get together and do an anniversary celebration. We did a golf trip, we started off in Scotland, then we went down to the South of France, and we were hanging out by the pool, drinking, going to dinner. It felt like we were on a road trip together, and as a 46-year-old, you don't really get that very often anymore.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on why there is no single GOAT in basketball
quotes.excerpt: There is no GOAT in basketball because there's multiple levels.

text_blocks.speaker: James Brayshaw
text_blocks.text: Is LeBron James in your view the greatest player ever?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: There is no GOAT in basketball because there's multiple levels. Kareem Abdul-Jabbar I think had the greatest career, Bill Russell won the most championships, Michael Jordan is the icon, and I think Kobe Bryant and what he did mentally for the game and really for athletes all around the world. But I would just say if you were to build a basketball player, you could not build a better basketball player than LeBron James. There's no skill set he doesn't have, there's no physical ability. So for me, if I was building a basketball player, he would be the person that I would build.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the toughness of Australian NBA players
quotes.excerpt: I love the grittiness to Australian players. It doesn't matter if you're an American player.
quotes.quote: I love the grittiness to Australian players. It doesn't matter if you're an American player, if you're a player that comes from Europe, if you're a player that comes from Australia, there's all a little bit of energy that each culture brings to the way they play basketball. With Australians, there's just a toughness to them, there's a grittiness to them. You don't find too many that will ever back down, and you love it. I have a tremendous amount of respect for anybody that will compete like their life is on the line, and you typically find that in Australian players.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the Rams' Super Bowl outlook with Aaron Donald and Miles Garrett
quotes.excerpt: The Rams are going to win the Super Bowl. We just added Aaron Donald back to Miles Garrett.
quotes.quote: The Rams are going to win the Super Bowl. I think the Super Bowl is in LA again this year. Obviously we're going to win because we won the last time it was in LA. We just added Aaron Donald back to Miles Garrett, which is kind of crazy that the fact that they have those two guys on the same defensive line. I don't know what that really means for you guys, but in America, there are insurance policies taken out when those guys are really trying to tackle you.
